name: Valheim Troll - Trundle

description:
Inspired by one of the greatest co-op survival games, this skin brings Valheim’s iconic blue troll to the Rift as Trundle. With his massive wooden club, authentic Valheim sounds, forest effects, and a glowing runestone pillar.
